title: Image requests got more ways through
summary:
This week made requests more resilient and larger, local tooling easier to use, and community projects easier to find.

Image generation gained Dreamshaper and Turbo fallback paths, then refined the route after a Dreamshaper failure to use the general ComfyUI call. Dreamshaper also stopped receiving a seed parameter that caused errors. The result is more chances for a request to complete when an earlier backend fails.

The text request limit rose fourfold, from 512,000 to 2,048,000 characters. The `mistral` identifier got a new backend and later gateway-routing changes; model listings now spell out `openai` as GPT-4.1-mini and `openai-large` as GPT-4.1, while `openai-reasoning` and `gemini` were removed from the available-model list.

The MCP server was reorganized around STDIO for local clients, with a `pollinations-mcp` CLI entry point, an `npx` setup path, and updated assistant instructions. A separate GitHub sign-in flow was also added.

Ten tools and projects joined the listings, spanning a browser enhancer, chat interfaces, nail art, Chinese-language FLUX generation, website creation, browser assistance, AI pipelines, and creative apps. A Featured category and improved sorting make that growing directory easier to browse.
